commits.message:
[CI](fix) bundle triton_dist into CI wheels (TRITON_BUILD_TD=ON) (#3088)

The wheel CI never sets TRITON_BUILD_TD, so setup_patch.py defaults it
to OFF and the built wheels ship without triton_dist or the
TritonDistributed compiler plugin. Users who pip-install such a wheel
over an installation whose wheel bundled triton_dist lose the package:
pip uninstall deletes the recorded files and leaves empty namespace
directories behind, so downstream imports fail with

  ImportError: cannot import name 'libshmem_device' from
  'triton_dist.language.extra' (unknown location)

Build the CI wheels with TRITON_BUILD_TD=ON, matching the build step in
integration-tests-ascend.yml, so the wheel bundles triton_dist from the
pinned Triton-distributed-ascend revision. Extend the Test-Wheels NPU
job to assert triton_dist/language/extra/libshmem_device.py is present
in the installed wheel.

Co-authored-by: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.comment: TritonToStructured 的 PtrAnalysis 新增 visitOperandBitcast：当 bitcast 前后张量形状一致、指针地址空间相同、且 pointee 存储位宽相同（i1 按 8 位计）时，递归分析源操作数并在标量基址上重建 bitcast，从而让 bool load/store 前端产生的 ptr<i1>→ptr<i8> 转换不再被当作不透明基址，避免非 SIMT 路径生成 stride 为 0 的 memref 描述符而被 BiShengIR 拒绝。修复点精准，并有 lit 用例覆盖 2D/3D 广播轴与无 bitcast 对照，另有端到端 pytest 覆盖 simd 与 simd_simt_template 两种模式。潜在风险是 getPointerStorageBits 把 i1 折为 8 位这一 Ascend ABI 假设需要在其他位宽（如 i4/f8）上有明确的'不识别即失败'行为，当前实现通过返回 nullopt 保守拒绝，行为合理。

commits.comment: 修复 TritonToLinalg 的 BlockDataParser 对零扩展（arith::ExtUIOp）动态偏移的处理缺失。原 parse() 的 op 分发链只有 ExtSIOp、TruncIOp、DivSIOp 等分支，没有 ExtUIOp，导致形如 arith.cmpi → arith.extui (i1→i32) 的结果被当作普通 SSA 值/掩码处理，从而两个后果：一是 i1 的 true 语义被误当作掩码或符号扩展（true 应该为 1，而不是继续转发到窄输入）；二是 i8 255 这类高位为 1 的值可能按有符号解释变成 -1，索引错行。实现上有两处改动：(1) 在 parse() 中增加 ExtUIOp 分支，调用 parseDynamicOffset<arith::ExtUIOp> 后直接 return success()，即把零扩展结果当作数值地址数据处理，而不是转发到输入（注释明确说明这是为了保留无符号语义）；(2) 在 parseDynamicOffset 模板里把 canExtractScalar 的初始值由固定的 false 改为 std::is_same_v<OpTy, arith::ExtUIOp>，使得单元素零扩展结果是可提取的动态标量，并在 cast 之后（而非之前）执行 tensor.extract，保证提取到的是扩展后的宽值而非窄输入。测试侧新增 extui_indirect_offset.mlir，包含 cmp_extui_row_offset（Inductor embedding 的 token/count 选择 count 作为行偏移）、unsigned_singleton_offset（i8 255 应索引 255）、cmp_extui_vector_offset（多个布尔应为逐元素偏移而非共享标量/控制 gather 的掩码）、unsigned_vector_offset 四个用例，并在 Ascend910B2 与 Ascend950PR（compile-on-910-95）以及 named-ops 开/关下验证。风险评估：改动仅限 Ascend 自有 pass，不涉及上游 BaseBackend/DriverBase 接口与 patch 文件；逻辑上 ExtUIOp 分支排在 ExtSIOp 之后、TruncIOp 之前，对既有 ExtSIOp 路径无侵入；canExtractScalar 的修改用 if constexpr/std::is_same_v 精确限定到 ExtUIOp，不会影响 tt.load 等既有可提取标量的判定。潜在风险是 parseDynamicOffset 是模板函数，新增分支后若其他调用点（例如 future 的 ExtUIOp 嵌套在 div/rem 中）行为发生变化需回归验证，且 ExtUIOp 作为标量提取入口后，未加 mask 的 LoadOp 语义与其它分支的一致性需要持续关注。总体看是针对 Inductor 生成模式（布尔数值参与地址计算）的正确性修复，属于中低风险。

test_impact.reason: 本次 commit 已经自带新增测试文件 extui_indirect_offset.mlir（112 行，4 个 FileCheck 用例，覆盖标量/向量、布尔 extui 与 i8 无符号 extui，并覆盖 named-ops 开关与 910-95 管线），因此无需再额外新增测试；但需要确认该文件已被 lit 测试套件正确发现并纳入 CI 看护（third_party/ascend/unittest/Conversion/General/TritonToLinalg 目录），同时建议在 code review 后补充对 tt.load/tt.store 携带 extui 偏移、extui 与 mask 组合、extui/extsi 混合链路的用例以巩固回归面。

commits.message:
[TLA](feat) Add scalar interface  (#3063)

* [TLA](feat) Add scalar abs interface

Expose tla.abs as a scalar wrapper around the standard Triton builtin.
Preserve input dtype and fixed-width integer semantics without implicit
buffers or SIMD broadcasts. Support bool, signed and unsigned integers,
and FP16/FP32; reject BF16, FP64, float8 and non-scalar inputs.

Add frontend contracts and writeback kernels with IR/compile/run stages.
Cover integer minima, both halves of 64-bit results, negative zero,
infinities, NaNs, literals and JIT helper composition.

Validation: 4927 scalar frontend/IR tests passed, 208 device-stage tests
skipped, and all 11 supported input types compiled to A5 ELF objects with
NPUIR 403adacfc11b in an isolated build. NPU accuracy was not run.

Assisted-by: AI
Signed-off-by: lbqg <songyaofei2@huawei.com>

* [TLA](fix) Ignore source locations in cdiv diagnostic comparisons

After Ascend backend initialization, dtype guards report cdiv errors at
the TLA and Triton call sites. Compare exception types and diagnostic
bodies so differing source excerpts do not fail equivalent negative cases.

Validation: all 4,819 scalar frontend contract tests passed both before
and after backend patch initialization in an isolated frontend runtime.
No NPU execution.

Assisted-by: AI
Signed-off-by: lbqg <songyaofei2@huawei.com>

construction and transformations in PtrAnalysisInfo; keep axis calculations,
proofs and materialization in PtrInfoUtils and integer proofs in IntegerUtils.
Preserve the original analysis behavior and brief logical-stage comments.

Validation: rebuilt six implementation and eleven test translation units
with clang 15 / LLVM 22; all 113 CPU tests pass with no skips. Applicable
pre-commit and git diff checks pass. Function-body comparison and independent
review confirm the original calculations, session recursion and IR placement.

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

* refactor(ascend): simplify shared pointer analysis facts

Construct valid axis facts at their producers instead of normalizing them
later, and consolidate arithmetic dispatch and shape updates. Keep simple
uniform and unit-dimension reshape facts and exact offsets for other
reshapes; remove per-field integer select reconstruction.

Use failure for unavailable Common rules results. Require complete offsets
for integer and ordinary-pointer results and bindings while retaining
BlockPtr descriptor reconstruction. Preserve dynamic tensor casts, slices
and insertions, and recover div/rem facts for proven aligned dynamic origins.

Cover axis consistency, failure propagation and rebinding, dynamic shapes,
exact offsets and conservative decomposition with public-analysis tests.
Reject dynamic-shape pointer bitcast rescaling before constructing an
invalid dense factor; preserve equal-width dynamic casts.
Validation: 133 CPU unit tests and applicable pre-commit checks pass.

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

* fix(ascend): recover uniform pointer-analysis origins

Complete uniform facts after slices remove unknown axes and after shape or
value-preserving casts propagate an incomplete bound origin. Reuse numerical
offsets, including attribute-backed pointer offsets, so subsequent uniform
multiplication retains its structured form.

Cover dynamic slice origins, signed casts, selected pointer broadcasts and
attribute-backed identity casts. The slice and reshape regressions fail on
the previous implementation; public-analysis tests and pre-commit pass.

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

* feat(ascend): infer loop-carried axes in common pointer analysis

Infer numeric for/while carrier and result axes by joining initial facts and
all control-flow edges to a finite fixed point. Join scalar-condition if
branches and construct origins and strides from the current SSA value, so
strides may change between iterations without losing affine structure.

Add isolated hypothesis queries that preserve configured Rules and explicit
bindings. Keep independent caches and recursion state for each hypothesis,
normalize unit axes before sampling, and retain exact values for unknown
axes. SCF rewriting stays with the consumers.

Cover changing strides, uniform and cross-dependent carriers, zero-trip
results, nonlinear later iterations, different while edge arities, nested
loops, partial/unit axes, extension rules and query isolation.
Validation: 146 public-analysis GTests and scoped pre-commit checks pass.

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

* refactor(ascend): simplify shared pointer analysis

Replace configurable pointer rules and bindings with one concrete analyzer,
loop-local hypothesis caches, and validated setInfo/reset entry points.
Consolidate parsing in PtrAnalysis and integer/offset helpers in Utils.

Represent descriptor preservation with ChangeInfo and retain exact numerical
offsets for partially structured tensors. Preserve block descriptor bases,
opaque per-lane pointer bases, and supported sub-axis facts needed by future
consumer migrations. Keep consumer rewrites outside the shared analyzer.

Update the public-analysis tests for the concrete API and its cache lifecycle,
control-flow proofs, descriptor reconstruction, and conservative fallbacks.
Validation: isolated Debug build and 151 public-analysis GTests pass.

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

* fix(ascend): preserve constant strides across numeric control flow

Carry known constant strides through the existing numeric SCF fixed point.
Uniform loop updates now preserve strides such as 1 and -2 instead of
reconstructing them from tensor samples. Keep a constant only when every
incoming edge agrees; losing it triggers another iteration even when the
axis remains Structured.

Maintain separate while before/after facts and preserve equal constants
across if branches. Keep the current SSA as the exact full offset, and use
runtime stride samples when a constant cannot be proved.

Cover uniform updates, cross-carrier invalidation, both while edges, nested
query order, branch joins, and partial axes. The four constant-preservation
regressions fail with the previous implementation.

Validation: isolated Debug build, 17 SCF tests, all 156 public-analysis
GTests, and scoped pre-commit checks pass.

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>
